UserRelatedRecordContent.name: UserRelatedRecordContent
UserRelatedRecordContent.description: Represents the link between a managed content record, an account, event, or opportunity record, and a user record.

ContentOwnerId.description: The user who owns the managed content record associated with the given account, event, or opportunity record.

ManagedContentId.description: The ID of the managed content record created for the associated Salesforce record. One unique managed content record is created per account, event, or opportunity record per user.

RelatedRecordId.description: The ID of the Salesforce record (e.g., account, opportunity, or event) associated with the managed content record.
